notes.title: Small Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback for our game!
[list]
[*] Regarding the issue of not being able to unlock some CGs after [One-click Skip]
[/list]

After emergency repairs by technical experts, it has now been successfully resolved! Please update the game as soon as possible to experience the latest repaired version.
Thank you again for your support and understanding! We will continue to work hard to provide you with a better gaming experience. I wish you a happy game!

notes.title: Major update announcement for "Hypnotic Card 2" is here 🎉😸
notes.notes:
Cat Cat brings you the latest game updates. Come and see what surprises this update has in store:
[olist]
[*] Added 5 new dream stones 💎: More dream stones, more adventures, are you ready to face new challenges?
[*] Theater supports serialized playback functionality 🎬: Goodbye to single-play, continuous playback, exhilarating to the point of flying!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086166/90b8f2692e166186fdd5a60d32ea692ee52e6cdc.gif[/img]
[*] Added camera reversal Settings 🎥 : Added camera reversal function in theater, bringing a new perspective experience!
[*] Fix issue 🔧: Fixed the level error when the Dream Tower mode was abandoned and then re-entered, ensuring that levels no longer run around randomly![/olist]
 Thank you for your support and companionship. Let's continue playing happily with the cats! ✨
